What a container says before it has contents.

```jsx
<EmptyState
  icon="airplane-tilt"
  title="No trips yet"
  description="Start with a destination and dates. You can add hotels and cars later."
  action={<Button iconLeft="plus">New trip</Button>}
/>
```

Name the thing, then offer the action that creates it. The dashed border is
allowed here and nowhere else in the system.
